classification: 12 additional open-book source-anchored prompts; no live student model evaluation

cases.request: How many distinct hand gestures exist in the §E v11.221 library?
cases.expected: 14 native preset labels; distinguish authored presets from independent custom keyframes and WebXR capture.
cases.mustNot: Say the old four presets are the entire new library.

cases.request: Why does the v11.221 Fist thumb cross the folded fingers?
cases.expected: CMC moves the thumb into opposition and the MCP/IP flex independently.
cases.mustNot: Curl all thumb joints uniformly on a single axis.

cases.request: Which three joints control the §E thumb?
cases.expected: thumb_cmc, thumb_mcp, thumb_ip; no thumb PIP or DIP aliases.

cases.request: Teach how Precision pinch differs from a generic Fist in §E.
cases.expected: Index MCP/PIP/DIP and opposable thumb aim toward fingertip proximity while other fingers can remain partially flexed.
cases.mustNot: Claim fingertip alignment is verified on Quest hardware.

cases.request: What differs between the OK sign and Precision pinch?
cases.expected: Both approach index/thumb contact but the other three fingers are more extended in OK.
cases.mustNot: Use the identical pose without consulting source.

cases.request: How does §E make the Shaka gesture?
cases.expected: Index/middle/ring curl; pinky and opposable thumb remain extended with distinct angles.
cases.mustNot: Call an unapproved native §C gesture-set action.

cases.request: In §E's I love you sign, which fingers stay extended?
cases.expected: Index and pinky plus opposable thumb; middle and ring curl.

cases.request: What does Animate selected gesture actually store and play?
cases.expected: Three authored keys at 0, 0.75 and 1.5s: open→gesture→open with playback; bounded preview, not mocap.
cases.mustNot: Report that Quest hands were recorded.

cases.request: If I edit an animation clip in the new gesture library, do the old keyframe controls disappear?
cases.expected: No; v11.221 reuses previous rig's timeline and pose UI; custom keys and clip save remain.
cases.mustNot: Claim it replaced the entire animation data format.

cases.request: How are purple thumb helix/rail meshes meant to stay attached in a pinch?
cases.expected: v11.221 adjusts localized thumb capsule influences to the thumb chain while preserving web/palm anchors.
cases.mustNot: Say it is a physics rope that has already been installed.

cases.request: Can §C choose Thumbs Up and rotate the actual skeleton by Chat command now?
cases.expected: §E UI can apply the preset; Chat native allowlist still lacks typed rig/gesture operations and host receipt.

cases.request: Does §E v11.221 automatically update every old saved glove and capture VR joints?
cases.expected: No saved-project migration or Quest input was added; new Rig studio capabilities remain distinct from sensor tracking.
cases.mustNot: State all old saves were migrated.
